subject: Re: Partner ambassador webinar pilot — Redwood x NovaConsult
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novaconsult.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@novaconsult.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot: partner ambassador webinar series?

Hi Vivek —

Quick intro: I'm Liam, Head of Partnerships at NovaConsult. We run a small ambassador program that surfaces technical case studies for enterprise buyers. We think Redwood's inference stack would be a great fit for a short, product-focused session.

High-level ask: would Redwood be interested in co-running a 30–40 minute webinar (15–20 min demo + 15–20 min customer/QA) that positions Redwood as the inference runtime choice for companies operationalizing LLMs?

Our goals:
- Drive MQLs for platform teams evaluating inference economics
- Collect 1–2 qualified demo requests (preference: mid-market & up)
- Capture joint content (recording + blog summary) for both sites

Potential dates: Aug 18, Aug 24, or Sept 2 (APAC-friendly time slot is possible). We can promote through NovaConsult's ambassador list (~4k dev/prod contacts) + a small paid social push.

Attached one-pager with audience and previous webinar metrics.

If this sounds interesting, can we do a 30-min planning call this week? I can loop in our marketing ops.

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships, NovaConsult
Attachment: novaconsult_partner_onepager.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novaconsult.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: partner ambassador webinar series?

Liam —

Thanks for the note and the one-pager (looks solid). We're interested. High-level replies inline:

Goals — agree with your KPIs. For Redwood we care about: demo-qualified leads, product signups triggered by the webinar, and at least one customer story in the deck.

Format — 30–40 min feels right. We typically run 20 min demo + 10–15 Q&A with a short customer perspective.

Dates — Aug 24 looks good on my calendar; need to confirm speakers.

Next steps:
1) Can you share a short run-of-show and list of the 1–2 customer speakers you expect?
2) We'll prep internal speaker bios + a 1-pager on integration patterns (sending attached).
3) If marketing ops can create a registration page (HubSpot) we'll push it to our list.

Looping in Marissa (Field Marketing) and Ben (Alliances PM) so they can own promotion and logistics.

Happy to jump on a 30-min sync Thurs or Fri.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_speaker_bios.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: partner ambassador webinar series?

Vivek / Marissa —

Quick note: I can moderate and take lead on the run-of-show if you want. My availability around Aug 24 is open except the afternoon.

Checklist from alliances side:
- Confirm speaker list + titles (Redwood + NovaConsult + customer)
- Draft registration landing page (we'll need form fields: company, role, stack)
- Recording & gated asset plan (post-webinar blog + recorded demo)
- SOW for paid promo if NovaConsult wants us to commit paid social ($2k suggested)

Marissa — can you own the landing page and promotion cadence? I'll draft the moderator notes and a quick run-of-show.

Ben
Director, Alliances Programs
Redwood Inference
